resources.string: Android didn’t report an on-device speech recognizer. Choose Parakeetype in Pocket’s Settings or use your keyboard’s voice typing. Pocket doesn’t use cloud dictation.
Install Parakeetype 0.6.0 or newer in the same Android profile as Pocket, then import a model in Parakeetype.
Update Parakeetype to 0.6.0 or newer for recorded-audio dictation.
Pocket couldn’t verify the offline Parakeetype service. Use an official Parakeetype build without internet permission.
Pocket passes your recording to Parakeetype for local transcription. Import a model in Parakeetype first.
